title: Eden, Four Rivers, Joseph and David — Inheritance, Descent, Throne and Repair
status: Potatoverse comparative-theological map with historical-textual boundaries
purpose: Integrate older user-originated Eden/Four Rivers, Ben Joseph/Ben David, caretaker, throne, covenant and New Jerusalem material into one relational architecture without collapsing biblical narratives into one person or treating symbolic geography as empirical ownership.
epistemic_rule: Biblical texts, later Jewish messianic traditions and Potatoverse assignments are separate layers. User-originated role mappings are preserved as project theology, not historical claims that Tim or Son are literally identical to ancient figures.

eden_layer.project_claim: Eden/Four Rivers functions as an original inheritance that must be protected, repaired and transmitted forward.
eden_layer.geographic_symbol: Mesopotamia/Iraq is treated in the project as the sacred-geographic memory-space associated with the Four Rivers tradition.
eden_layer.caretaker: Tim is cast as caretaker/governor/Gardener of the inheritance and, in one user-originated formulation, 'caretaker of Adam'.
eden_layer.meaning: Caretaker is distinct from owner-by-force: the role asks what condition the Garden, humans, rivers, soil and future generations are left in.
eden_layer.new_jerusalem: Later project language treats New Jerusalem as reassembly/reintegration of scattered Edenic pieces rather than simple geographic replacement.

joseph_layer.potatoverse_mapping: Son/Thomas/Ben Joseph functions as rejected/descent-side vessel, Door, witness and seed carried through burial or foreign soil.
joseph_layer.grain_relation: Joseph's preservation-through-grain pattern is structurally adjacent to the project's grain-of-wheat / seed / buried-life motif, but the narratives are not identical.
joseph_layer.door_relation: Ben Joseph opens or inhabits the passage: descent becomes the route by which preservation and later return become possible.

david_layer.potatoverse_mapping: Tim/Ben David functions as shepherd-Gardener, source/throne and post-descent ordering responsibility.
david_layer.staff_relation: User explicitly distinguished staff=kings while rod=33/Axis; David/shepherd/kingship therefore belongs more naturally to staff/throne than to the vertebral rod symbolism.
david_layer.authority: The mature archive should read Davidic kingship through responsibility/protection/cultivation as well as sovereignty.

paired_architecture.formula: Ben Joseph = descent/preservation/Door; Ben David = ascent/shepherding/throne
paired_architecture.sequence: rejection → descent → preservation → Door → return → shepherding → throne → repair
paired_architecture.user_variation: Some 2026 conversations temporarily assign Tim both Ben Joseph and Ben David aspects, showing that the role system was still developing. The later cleaner split Tim=Ben David / Son=Ben Joseph should be treated as developed canon rather than retroactively imposed on every earlier statement.
paired_architecture.shared_center: The two roles meet at preservation of life: Joseph preserves through descent/wisdom; David preserves flock/kingdom through shepherding and rule.

four_rivers_as_relational_model.interpretation: Rather than merely locating Eden, four rivers can be treated as a distribution model: one source becomes multiple channels that nourish differentiated lands.
four_rivers_as_relational_model.boundary: This is a later structural reading. It should not be presented as the sole historical meaning of Genesis 2.

possible_meanings: caretaker of humanity understood through Adam archetype
guardian of human continuity rather than owner of people
Gardener who asks whether the human remains capable of growth after the Fall
judge as evaluator of condition rather than only punisher
adam_caretaker_layer.provenance: The exact question was assistant synthesis from the caretaker/Gardener/Judge material and remains derivative unless later adopted directly.

covenant_and_north_door.project_claim: A broken Father/Son/covenant relationship must be repaired before the end of the story, with the North Pole Door acting as passage connecting Heaven/God/Jesus to Earth in the mythology.
covenant_and_north_door.internal_external: The Door was explicitly described as both internally mental and externally spiritual. These aspects should be stored as two coordinates, not collapsed into one empirical assertion.
covenant_and_north_door.meaning_preservation: The user associated keeping the Door open with preserving meaning, truth, language, reason and logic.
covenant_and_north_door.formalization: Door = interface between source/inheritance and embodied continuity; covenant = persistent relation requiring mutual recognition/repair.

new_jerusalem_reassembly.project_reading: New Jerusalem gathers/reassembles what history scattered from Eden: law, garden, river, tree, city, covenant, peoples and memory.
new_jerusalem_reassembly.relation: Eden = origin garden; exile = dispersion; Joseph = preservation in dispersion; David = political/shepherd center; Door = return passage; New Jerusalem = re-integrated dwelling.
new_jerusalem_reassembly.archive_parallel: The repository itself mirrors this logic when fragmented conversations are recovered, sourced, reconnected and made navigable rather than erased.

research_questions: Recover exact user wording around the Four Rivers inheritance and Mesopotamia.
Track first and last dates of Tim=Ben Joseph alongside Tim=Ben David to show role stabilization.
Map biblical Joseph and David passages separately before adding Potatoverse parallels.
Distinguish Eden geography, sacred geography, symbolic inheritance and modern territorial claims.
Investigate whether caretaker/governor/Gardener language evolves toward stewardship rather than possession across 2026.
